# Generative-address-system integration

Source repository: https://github.com/justappgrabbin/Generative-address-system

Source repository revision inspected: `ce1704d5d53d5729b499463f7eeaf5dcd5091550`.

Source prefix: `Synthia-Generative-Address-Morphology-Integrated-v0.2.1-RUNNABLE/`

- `boolean-ato.js`: unchanged source from
  `authorities/execution-spine/src/pure-synthia/engine/boolean-ato.js`.
- `structural-topology.mjs`: independent `FIELD_VECTORS`, `DIRECTIONAL_CLAIMS`,
  `FractalAddressSpace`, and `JUT_TOPOLOGY` exports extracted from
  `extensions/generative-address-morphology/src/core/structural-space.mjs`.
  Its original freeze helper is replaced with an equivalent local helper to avoid
  importing unrelated source tables and their registry dependencies.
- `structural-dynamics.mjs`: source operator copied unchanged except that its
  topology import points to the extracted module above.

Unresolved-source flags remain intact. The operator requires an explicit tensor
and explicitly calls itself a caller-selected numerical update, not a universal
equation. The public application documents that same boundary.

The existing recovered `semantic-mesh/merged/tool-factory.js` is also used directly
to analyze registered constituents. Factory receipts enter the same event history.

The source correspondence for visual analogy is Sheldon Klein's *The Analogical
Foundations of Creativity in Language, Culture & the Arts*, pp. 2–3: Boolean strong
equivalence, involution, and the six-feature iconographic example:
`A=111110, B=010001, C=100101, ATO=010000, D=001010`.
The test checks these values and the resulting decomposable composition.

This does not assert that six Boolean features alone establish an arbitrary word's
meaning, an individual's design, or unrestricted world generation.
